figurative_meaning_bn: দুর্গম বা দূরের পথে চলার পরিশ্রম
figurative_meaning_en: The toil or hardship of traveling on difficult or distant paths
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভ্রমণে অনেক পথকষ্ট সহ্য করতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Traveling involves a lot of path hardships.
The path hardship to the village is unbearable.
note: Refers to physical and metaphorical struggles in travel, common in Bengali literature.
